FULL TEXT:
DEPARTMENT OF FRENCH & FRANCOPHONE STUDIES
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH
URGENT
Applications are invited for four (04) posts of Guest Faculty in French. Applications
complete in all respects (please refer to : https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.pdf) along with a recent
passport size photograph, copies of degrees, certificates of merit, awards (scholarships /
fellowships), lists of publications and other supporting documents must reach the Department office
by 18/08/2023, 2023 (Friday) before 5:00 PM by post or by email (chairfrench@pu.ac.in)
No. of Posts: 04 (four)
Essential
Qualifications
: 1. M.A. in French with at least 55% marks (50% for SC/ST/Physically &
Visually Handicapped) or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever
grading system is followed at the Master’s degree level in a relevant subject
from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited
foreign University.
2. UGC NET
3. Ph.D. in the relevant subject (French)
Note: i) Candidates, who have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University
Grants Commission (Minimum standard and Procedure for Award of Ph.D. Degree)
Regulations, 2009, shall be exempted from the requirement of the minimum eligibility
condition of NET.
ii) The appointment shall be made as per University Grants Commission Regulation, 2018.
(UNIVERSITY GRANTS COMMISSION NOTIFICATION, New Delhi -18th July, 2018)
iii) The superannuated teachers may also be considered for engagement as Guest Faculty
subject to a maximum age limit of 70 years and approval of the competent authority.
iv) In case suitable candidates having the above mentioned essential qualifications are not
available, candidates without NET qualification may be considered subject to the approval
of the competent authority.
v) The above assignment will be on lecture basis with an honorarium of Rs. 1500/- per lecture
with an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month.
vi) The candidate shall have to give an undertaking that he / she will not draw any fellowship/
stipend or any financial assistance from any agency till he / she is teaching in the
Department of Panjab University, Chandigarh.
(Dr. Ramnik Aurora)
Academic Incharge
